lane: Content: v1 data for the daily 'Một câu cho hôm nay' feature, books Suy tưởng, Kinh Pháp Cú and Binh pháp Tôn Tử (Owner approved the plan 27/11/2026)
goal: Write three bilingual data files (Meditations 59 items after round-1 review dropped st-05-28, Dhammapada 60, Art of War 60): a short quote translated by Nilaza into Vietnamese from the public-domain English (Long 1862, Müller 1881, Giles 1910) with a check against the original wording, a 2-3 sentence gloss and one open question per item, with a draft review block, so the app agent can load them and nilaza-content-review can review them. Round-1 content review fixes were applied on 27/11/2026.
successCriteria: packages/content/data/book-quotes/suy-tuong.json (59 items), kinh-phap-cu.json (60) and binh-phap-ton-tu.json (60) exist with unique ids in the agreed format and the agreed schema.

Every quote is a real line at the stated reference in the public-domain text (Long 1862, Max Müller 1881, Lionel Giles 1910); the Vietnamese is Nilaza's own translation from that English base and no modern copyrighted translation is copied; the source label says so and does not claim a direct translation from the original language.
Gloss and question contain none of the banned prediction or verdict words, vi and en say the same thing, quote.vi is 220 characters or fewer.
Lines that are risky (killing, deception of close people, spies, burning, shaming verses, death standing alone) are skipped and listed in the handoff.
A throwaway check confirms counts, unique ids, non-empty fields and banned words; nothing else in the repository changes.
untouchedSurfaces: No app, Admin, backend, SQL, Edge Function, validator or loader change; another agent builds those against the same schema.
PLAN.md, skills, knowledge briefs and personas-books.json are not edited.
No push, PR, merge or deploy from this task.

impact.entryPoint: Data files only; the 'Một câu cho hôm nay' feature built by the app agent reads them, there is no user-facing entry in this task.
impact.dataWrite: Three JSON files under packages/content/data/book-quotes/ in the repository; no database write.
impact.backendContract: No API, Edge Function or provider change; the files follow the agreed schemaVersion 1 shape.

impact.privacySafety: Public-domain texts and Nilaza-written commentary only; no user data. Gloss and question avoid prediction and verdict words and advice on money, health or law; risky lines are skipped.
impact.observability: Each file carries a review block (draft, no reviewer) so the later review record can track status per file.
impact.rollback: Delete the three data files or revert the commit; nothing else depends on them until the app branch merges.
